description: T-4080: edge of BETA.DIST's #NUM! band at a huge first shape. Row r = (a, b) with a in 2E9, 2.25E9, 2.5E9, 2.75E9, 3E9, 3.5E9, 4E9, 4.5E9, 5E9, 5.5E9, 6E9, 7E9, 8E9, 1E10 (outer) and b in 30, 30.5, ..., 39.5, 40 (inner, 21 rows per a). Cumulative BETA.DIST(x,a,b,TRUE) at four tails: A, B, C at x = 1 - q/a with q the upper quantile of Gamma(b) at 1E-6, 0.05 and 0.5 (so I is about 1E-6, 0.05, 0.5), D at x = 1 - 1E-12 (I about 1). E: the density BETA.DIST(x,a,b,FALSE) at column B's x, for b in 30, 37.5, 39.5 and 40.
